dialogue.content: （本日は宜しくお願い致します。お時間になりましたら はじめさせていただきます。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for meeting with me today. We'll begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそ宜しくお願い致します)
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは！相談員です。本日はお越しいただきありがとうございます。初めに年齢と性別、ご相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello! I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 高校２年　女部活の事で悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm a second-year high school student, female. I'm struggling with something related to my club activities.

dialogue.content: 高校２年生ですね。教えていただきありがとうございます。部活のどんなことで悩んでいますか？
dialogue.English: You're a second-year in high school. Thank you for sharing. What aspects of your club activities are concerning you?

dialogue.content: 一年生にどう注意したらいいかわかりません。
dialogue.English: I don’t know how to address the first-years.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。後輩の方に対してですね。それは色々と考えてしまうかもしれないですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see—so it’s about your juniors. That can certainly give you a lot to think about...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、部活は何の部活か教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Could you tell me what kind of club it is?

dialogue.content: 女子バスケです
dialogue.English: It's the girls' basketball team.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。きっと日頃から頑張っておられるのだと思います。１年生のどんなところを注意することが多いですか？？
dialogue.English: I see. I'm sure you all work very hard every day. What sorts of things about the first-years do you often feel the need to correct?

dialogue.content: まだ注意出来ていなくて‥
dialogue.English: I haven't actually been able to say anything yet...

dialogue.content: 移動が遅かったり３年生への配慮がらなかったりが気になります
dialogue.English: I'm concerned that they're slow to move and aren't considerate enough towards the third-year students.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。教えていただきありがとうございます。それは気になりますね。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for explaining. That would certainly be concerning.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。ちなみに、部員は２年生、１年生何人くらいいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: That's right. By the way, how many second-year and first-year members are on the team?

dialogue.content: ３年生はもう引退かな？
dialogue.English: Have the third-years already retired?

dialogue.content: ２年は11人１年は10人で３年はあと少しで引退です
dialogue.English: There are 11 second-years and 10 first-years. The third-years will be retiring soon.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。３年生はもうすぐ引退なのですね。いよいよ２年生が部をひっぱる時期もきますから、後輩の態度が気になるのも当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. So the third-years are retiring soon. The time is coming when the second-years will have to lead the team, so it's natural for you to be concerned about the younger members' attitudes.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今は１年生、２年生ともに１０人、１１人と同じくらいの人数がいる中、日頃の関係はどんな感じでしょうか？気になる点はいくつかあるとして、他の方含め部の雰囲気はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: With about the same number of first and second-year students on the team, what are your day-to-day relationships like? Aside from the concerns you've mentioned, how is the overall atmosphere of the team?

dialogue.content: ふつうだと思います
dialogue.English: I think it's pretty normal.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。普通ということで、悪くはないようで良かったです。
dialogue.English: I see. Well, if it's normal, I'm glad to hear it doesn't seem to be a bad atmosphere.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみにあなたの立場としてはリーダー的な立ち位置でしょうか？今後の部長候補など・・・
dialogue.English: By the way, are you in a leadership position? Perhaps a candidate for the next team captain...

dialogue.content: まだはっきり決まってはないですがその可能性もある感じです
dialogue.English: It hasn't been officially decided, but it feels like that's a possibility.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。教えていただきありがとうございます。そうした中、後輩の指導に対して悩むのは当然ですね。部活に真剣に取り組んでいるからこそ、ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing. In that case, it's completely understandable to be worried about how to guide the younger members. It's because you're so dedicated to the team.

dialogue.content: 部活の頻度はどれくらいですか？
dialogue.English: How often does the team practice?

dialogue.content: 大体毎日です
dialogue.English: Pretty much every day.

dialogue.content: 毎日ですか。がんばっていますね。頻度が多い分、後輩の態度も気になるかと思います。
dialogue.English: Every day? You're working very hard. I imagine practicing that often makes the younger members' attitudes even more noticeable.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね。あなた以外の人で１年生に注意したり、態度がきになっているかたはいるのでしょうか？いかがですか？？
dialogue.English: I understand. Besides you, is there anyone else who has spoken to the first-years or is concerned about their attitude? What's the situation?

dialogue.content: みんなで一年生が来るの遅いよね。とか話したりはした事はあります
dialogue.English: We’ve talked among ourselves, like, “The first-years come late, don’t they?”

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。他の２年生など上級生も、１年生が遅いなど、気になっているのですね。実際に注意した人はいますか？現部長や顧問の先生はいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So the other second-years and upperclassmen are also concerned about the first-years being late. Has anyone actually said anything to them? What about the current captain or the faculty advisor?

dialogue.content: ３年生が前に注意してたけど今もまた遅い事が多いです私達の時は２年生から注意されたりしたので言った方がよいのでは。と思ってます
dialogue.English: A third-year corrected them before, but they're often late again now. When we were first-years, the second-years would correct us, so I feel like we should say something.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。ご自分の時はそうだったのら、なおさら気になりますよね。そのように思われて当然だと思います。では、あなたが１年生に”どう注意するか悩む”のはどのようなことから悩むのか原因は思い浮かびますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Since that's how it was for you, it must be even more concerning. It's perfectly natural to feel that way. So, when you worry about "how to correct the first-years," can you think of what the underlying cause of that worry is?

dialogue.content: 注意したら1年生との仲が悪くならないように上手く言えるか不安だからかな。
dialogue.English: I guess it's because I'm worried that if I say something, it might hurt my relationship with them, and I'm not sure if I can say it in the right way.

dialogue.content: すみません仲が悪くならないか？上手くいえるか不安って感じです
dialogue.English: Sorry, I mean I'm worried about our relationship souring and whether I can say it well.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、そうですよね。そう思いますよね。教えていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, yes, that makes sense. It's natural to feel that way. Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 仲良くやっていきたいからこそ、不安をおぼえますよね。本当に部の全体のことをしっかり見ているのただと思います。そんなあなたはとても立派ですね。
dialogue.English: It's precisely because you want to get along that you feel anxious. I think you're really looking out for the team as a whole. That's very admirable of you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: しっかりした先輩だと感じました。１年生の様子に顧問の先生からは何かお話しはありますか？
dialogue.English: I can tell you're a very responsible upperclassman. Has the faculty advisor said anything about the first-years' behavior?

dialogue.content: 顧問の先生は特にないです
dialogue.English: No, the advisor hasn't said anything in particular.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。上級生を信頼されていからこそ、見守っているのかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Perhaps it's because they trust the upperclassmen that they're just observing for now.

dialogue.content: そうですかね先生が来るときまでに来ているから気付いてないのもあるかもです
dialogue.English: Maybe. It could also be that they arrive by the time the teacher gets there, so the teacher just hasn't noticed.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなんですね。遅くくる…という部分だとそれもあるかもしれないですね。では、あなたは今後、どんな風になっていったら今の悩みが少しでも軽減すると思われますか？何か思い浮かぶことはあるでしょうか？？
dialogue.English: I see, that makes sense. Regarding the lateness, that might be the case. So, what kind of outcome in the future do you think would help alleviate your current worries, even just a little? Does anything come to mind?

dialogue.content: 1年生が気づいてくれたらいいと思います
dialogue.English: I think it would be good if the first-years would just realize it themselves.

dialogue.content: ええ、そう思われるのですね。それはそうですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can see why you'd feel that way. That would be ideal.

dialogue.content: 今のままだとどんどんダラダラしちゃいそうな気がします
dialogue.English: I feel like if things stay as they are, they'll just become more and more lax.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは心配になりますね。では、どうしたら気づいてくれそうか、何かアイデアは浮かびますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That is a cause for concern. Well then, do you have any ideas about what might make them realize it?

dialogue.content: なので一度注意するのがいいかなと思っています
dialogue.English: So I think it might be best to just say something to them once.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。そう思いますよね。以前は３年生が注意しても、また今遅い…ということでしたが、繰り返さないために出来る事があるとしたら、どんなことがあるか少しでも改善の糸口が見つかりそうなことはありそうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. That makes sense. You mentioned that even after a third-year corrected them, they're late again now... To prevent this from repeating, can you think of anything that might be done? Any small thing that could lead to an improvement?

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I’m not sure.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうお思いなのですね。私個人の考えなので、違和感があったらスルーしていただきたいのですが、３年生が今はいる段階で、顧問の先生も自体を把握していない可能性がある…ということでまずは顧問も３年生も含め、これからについて全体で話し合いをするというのは出来そうでしょうか？そして、その際、あなたが１年生の態度が気になっているけれども
dialogue.English: I understand. This is just my personal thought, so please feel free to disregard it if it doesn't feel right, but while the third-years are still around and the advisor might not be aware of the situation... would it be possible to have a meeting with everyone, including the advisor and the third-years, to discuss the team's future? And at that time, you could mention that you're concerned about the first-years' attitudes, but...

dialogue.content: 今後も関係性を良く保つために、どう伝えればいいかに心を砕いている・・・というこも正直にお伝えしてみられては、と思ったのですがいかがでしょうか？まずは２年生で相談するなどして、全体の話し合いなどは可能性として、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: ...you could also honestly express that you're struggling with how to communicate this in a way that maintains a good relationship. How does that sound? As a first step, perhaps you could talk with the other second-years, and then consider a full team meeting as a possibility?

dialogue.content: はい。3年生や顧問の先生など大事にしたくないのでまずは２年ではなしてみます
dialogue.English: Yes. I don't want to make a big deal of it with the third-years or the faculty advisor, so I'll try talking with the second-years first.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですね。大ごとにしないためにはまずは２年生で話し合うのは、いいですね！
dialogue.English: Yes, that's a good idea. To avoid making a big deal of it, talking amongst the second-years first is a great plan!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今日はあなたの大切なお話しをありがとうございました。しっかりと解決には至りませんでしたが、とても真面目で、前向きに努力されているあなたならきっと乗り越えて行けると思います。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your important concerns with me today. Although we haven't reached a complete solution, I believe that someone as earnest and proactive as you will surely be able to overcome this.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございます。頑張り屋さんのあなたを心から応援しておりますので、また何かありましたらいつでもいらしてください。
dialogue.English: Thank you, too. I'll be sincerely rooting for you, as you're clearly a hard worker. Please feel free to come back anytime if anything else comes up.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 本日のご相談は終了となりますがよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: This concludes our session for today. Is that all right with you?

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、本日はありがとうございました。あなたのこれからを応援しております。またいつでもお越しください。では終了させていただきます。
dialogue.English: Thank you again for today. I'll be cheering for you. Please come back anytime. I will now end the session.

dialogue.content: （貴重なお時間をありがとうございました。大変勉強になりました。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your valuable time. This has been a great learning experience for me. Thank you.)
